items.distractor_fact: Оның досының шотында {D} теңге бар еді.
items.gloss_en: Her friend had a balance of D tenge in the account. No case suffix attaches to the numeral; теңге stays unqualified after any numeral.
items.entity_note: a different person's (her friend's) bank account, not Aigerim's

items.gloss_en: The neighboring partnership's account had D tenge left over. The locative/possessive suffixes attach to шот(ы), not to the numeral, so the sentence holds for any value.
items.entity_note: a different partnership's account, not the one in the story

items.distractor_fact: Көрші отбасының сол айдағы шығысы {D} теңге болды.
items.gloss_en: The neighboring family's expenses for that same month were D tenge. Suffixes attach to шығысы, not the numeral; теңге is unqualified after any numeral.
items.entity_note: a different family's expenses, not this family's income/expense pair

items.distractor_fact: Басқа команда сол маусымда {D} гол соқты.
items.gloss_en: Another team scored D goals that same season. Гол stays unqualified after any numeral, so no case/number agreement varies with the value.
items.entity_note: a different team's own goal count in the same season

items.distractor_fact: Басқа трейдердің сол айдағы табысы {D} доллар болды.
items.gloss_en: Another trader's gain for that same month was D dollars. Доллар is invariant after any numeral, and possessive suffixes attach to табысы, not to the numeral.
items.entity_note: a different trader's gain, not this trader's gain/loss pair

items.distractor_fact: Басқа гольфшы басқа раундта {D} соққы жасады.
items.gloss_en: Another golfer made D strokes in a different round. Соққы does not inflect after a numeral, so the sentence is grammatical for any integer.
items.entity_note: a different golfer, in a different round/course whose par is never stated

items.distractor_fact: Көрші үйдегі лифттің көрсеткіші {D} деп тұр.
items.gloss_en: The elevator in the neighboring building shows D. The postposition деп takes the bare numeral, with no case suffix attaching to it.
items.entity_note: a different elevator in another building, whose ground-floor reference is never stated

items.distractor_fact: В командасы басқа ойында {D} гол соқты.
items.gloss_en: Team V scored D goals in a different match. Гол is unqualified after any numeral, and possessive suffixes attach to command(as)ы, not the numeral.
items.entity_note: a third team (Team V), in a separate match from the A-vs-B game the question compares
